short: Differentiable-synthesizer decoding (M06) and autoencoder guidance (M02) are standard: the group posted both in 2021. New: 48 participants, mostly low-density grids; no listener test.
position: The paper [@chen2024neural] changes the intermediate representation (M06), 18 acoustic parameters rendered by a differentiable synthesizer, and the training-only supervision (M02), Praat-supervised speech-autoencoder targets. Both depart from the usual approach (Appendix) but are not new: the authors cite their earlier pipeline and name Praat supervision as the change (§ Methods; § Discussion), and the 2021 preprint already had the parameter decoder, synthesizer and causal variants on five participants [@wang2023distributed]. New here are scale and coverage: 48 participants, 43 on low-density clinical grids, right-hemisphere implants, and Swin and LSTM decoders. The held-out-word test is not new, since novel sentences were tested in 2019 [@anumanchipalli2019speech]. Natural speech is claimed without a listener test, which single-word ECoG synthesis had in 2019 [@herff2019generating]. The causal PCC of 0.797 reconstructs 50 trained words within participants; held-out words are called comparable (Fig. 2b), with no numeric fold means or chance level.
